TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Delhi Traffic Police has made elaborate traffic arrangements in view of the Rehearsals of Beating Retreat at and around Vijay Chowk.

Date: 28.01.2026
Time: 04:00 PM – 06:00 PM

 📍TRAFFIC RESTRICTIONS
-Vijay Chowk will remain closed for general traffic
-No traffic on Raisina Road (Krishi Bhawan R/A towards Vijay Chowk)
-No traffic beyond R/A Dara Shikoh Road, R/A Krishna Menon Marg & R/A Sunehri Masjid towards Vijay Chowk
-Kartavya Path closed between Vijay Chowk and Rafi Marg–Kartavya Path Crossing
📍SUGGESTED ROUTES
Ring Road, Ridge Road, Aurobindo Marg, Madarsa T-Point, Safdarjung Road–Kamal Ataturk Marg, Rani Jhansi Road, Minto Road, etc.

📍Commuters are advised to plan their journeys accordingly

📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
